comments.author: @SWL-123-9
comments.text: Loved Juneau, and all of alaska, incredible beauty......unfortunately, the tourist and cruise ship industry has kind of eradicated the charm of these places, with souvenirs and t shirt shops, and barkers on the sidewalks literally shouting at passerby to get them into the shops. Gift shops claiming to be "going out of business-get your t shirts now"! only to claim the same sale again when the next cruise ship arrives. Not what I hoped to see.....

comments.author: @UncoverNowTV
comments.text: Visiting Alaska was an unforgettable experience. Standing in front of towering glaciers, breathing the crisp mountain air, and watching wildlife in their natural habitat made me feel completely connected to nature. It's one of those places that leaves you with memories you'll never forget.
